name: NagaCorp Ltd.
summary: NagaCorp Ltd., an investment holding company, engages in the management and operation of a hotel and casino complex in the Kingdom of Cambodia. It operates through two segments, Casino Operations; and Hotel and Entertainment Operations. The company owns, manages, and operates NagaWorld, an integrated hotel and entertainment complex that consists of gaming tables, electronic gaming machines, public gaming areas, VIP referral halls, suites and rooms, food and beverage outlets, a live performance venue, event spaces, and a shopping mall.
